adapter_model: the interpreter drives the public driver boundary exactly as the real adapter does: a surfaced DriverOutput::Failure HALTS the run at that instant (ws-testee io_loop maps it to LoopOutcome::ProtocolFailure and stops), so no schedule action, drain poll, or quiescence poll follows a Failure; Terminal-after-Failure is impossible by construction and additionally asserted

terminal_disposition_model: every full schedule ends in one of two typed dispositions, mirroring the real adapter: the clean Terminal from the absorbing Closed state (30372 runs), or the halt at the first surfaced fatal Failure (49548 runs, exactly one surfaced failure each) — the poisoned core retains its final state per the oracle's partial-execution semantics and the adapter stops there. Since owner decision us017-post-terminal-owner-decision-2026-08-28 these are ORDERED, not mutually exclusive: a schedule may converge cleanly, take its one Terminal, and then have further work pushed at the already-converged connection, which the core refuses — so a halted run may legitimately carry one preceding clean Terminal. The invariant that holds unconditionally is the ordering one: no Terminal is ever observed AFTER a surfaced Failure. Both classes fully quiesce, and clean-terminal runs reconcile every accepted command exactly once

execution_status.detail: `bounded_exploration_is_exhaustive_and_every_schedule_upholds_the_invariants` fails its coverage assertion `closed_terminal_runs > 0` ("clean convergence explored"), and `retention_minimizes_every_named_fault_and_pins_the_artifacts` fails with "fault lost-command was not detected by the exploration". Cause: the coalescing fix in this revision makes every admitted transport-EOF notification a separate scored event, and EVERY schedule in the fixed five-actor program set runs both program 3 (which ends in TransportEof) and program 5 (which ends in Shutdown) to completion. The second notification therefore always reaches an already-Closed core and halts the run, so no schedule converges cleanly and the seeded lost-command fault can no longer manifest.
execution_status.implication: the clean-convergence population reported in every previous revision of this document (52924, then 50221, then 30372 runs) existed ONLY because multiple EOF notifications were silently coalescing. Those figures were partly an artifact of the defect, not evidence of the driver converging cleanly under those schedules.
execution_status.requires: an owner decision on the exploration's actor program set. PROGRAMS is test scaffolding and is NOT pinned in assurance/concurrency/plan.json (verified), so changing it does not violate the preregistered plan — but it materially changes what US-017's systematic-concurrency evidence covers, and the lane did not change it unilaterally.
